img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS (unified protocol v1.0). Left: Set IoU (Jaccard); right: avg predicted set size. R11 TECP-14B wins on CLINC150 single-label IoU (0.954), but its argmax sets collapse on multi-intent MixATIS/MixSNIPS (IoU 0.38/0.53); QP-10shot emits 4.2-4.9 candidates (true intents ≤3) yet trails Ours on both multi-intent sets. Ours (red) attains the best multi-intent IoU on MixSNIPS (0.757) with tight sets (1.5-1.8). Conformal baselines CICC/MULACONF produce sets of 78-748 intents and are excluded from the compact-set comparison; few-shot LLM 14b-10shot leads raw IoU (0.87/0.95) but provides no coverage guarantee or OOS refusal.
